# Generated by scripts/images.sh. Rendered from each chart's default
# values, so this is a superset: a document that disables a component
# still sees its image here. Over-listing costs bytes, under-listing
# costs an install on a site that cannot fetch what is missing.
#
# INCOMPLETE for operator-managed components. victoria-metrics-k8s-stack
# templates VMSingle, VMAgent, VMAlert and VMAlertmanager custom
# resources whose images the VictoriaMetrics operator fills in at run
# time; the chart states only their tags, with the repository in a
# renovate comment. Reading a comment would be a guess, and a guess in
# a carry list is discovered in a room with no way to fetch what is
# missing. Take those from a cluster that has run the stack.
#
